mapper.select: SELECT p.sort_order AS sortOrder, p.position_name AS positionName, p.demand_count AS demandCount, (p.demand_count - COALESCE(t.total_onboarded, 0)) AS remainingCount, t.channel AS channel, t.sub_channel AS subChannel, COALESCE(t.resume_received, 0) AS resumeReceived, COALESCE(t.written_exam_scheduled, 0) AS writtenExamScheduled, COALESCE(t.written_exam_completed, 0) AS writtenExamCompleted, COALESCE(t.written_exam_accumulated, 0) AS writtenExamAccumulated, COALESCE(t.first_interview, 0) AS firstInterview, COALESCE(t.second_interview, 0) AS secondInterview, COALESCE(t.hired, 0) AS hired, COALESCE(t.hired_accumulated, 0) AS hiredAccumulated, COALESCE(t.offer_signed, 0) AS offerSigned, COALESCE(t.offer_rejected, 0) AS offerRejected, COALESCE(t.contract_broken, 0) AS contractBroken, COALESCE(t.pending_contract, 0) AS pendingContract, COALESCE(t.considering, 0) AS considering, COALESCE(t.pending_communication, 0) AS pendingCommunication, COALESCE(t.total_onboarded, 0) AS totalOnboarded FROM ( SELECT position_name, channel, sub_channel, SUM(resume_received) AS resume_received, SUM(written_exam_scheduled) AS written_exam_scheduled, SUM(written_exam_completed) AS written_exam_completed, MAX(written_exam_accumulated) AS written_exam_accumulated, SUM(first_interview) AS first_interview, SUM(second_interview) AS second_interview, SUM(hired) AS hired, MAX(hired) AS hired_accumulated, SUM(offer_signed) AS offer_signed, SUM(offer_rejected) AS offer_rejected, SUM(contract_broken) AS contract_broken, SUM(pending_contract) AS pending_contract, SUM(considering) AS considering, SUM(pending_communication) AS pending_communication, SUM(weekly_onboarded) AS total_onboarded FROM weekly_recruitment GROUP BY position_name, channel, sub_channel ) t RIGHT JOIN recruitment_position p ON p.position_name = t.position_name ORDER BY p.sort_order, t.channel, t.sub_channel
